semantic_types.description: Type not yet inferred by the prototype

representations.description: Verifier refuses in finalized executable MIR
C long / LLVM i64 Boolean adapter ABI; true iff nonzero, distinct from semantic Bool
Declared borrowed or owned C string ABI
Static code address with declared borrowed boxed ingress and distinct owned boxed result; never a heap value
Static code address of a module-local adapter with the runtime callable entry ABI: a borrowed argument vector and count in, a distinct owned boxed result out; never a heap value
Borrowed contiguous array of borrowed boxed pointers valid only for the call; the callee neither retains nor releases the array or its elements

sugar_roles.description: Original parser operation without a desugaring role
Convert the expression of one interpolation segment through its declared protocol target
Combine ordered string segments once without reparsing expression text

nominal_domains.name: none
nominal_domains.description: No additional semantic refinement is asserted

nominal_domains.name: unplanned
nominal_domains.description: Placeholder refused by finalized executable MIR graph verification

nominal_domains.name: boxed_pointer
nominal_domains.description: Owned boxed pointer result; argument representations and dispositions are explicit; source function parameters borrow boxed pointers; graph correspondence is required

nominal_domains.name: ordered_unknown
nominal_domains.description: Conservative effect; preserve evaluation order and make no purity or reordering claim

nominal_domains.name: pure
nominal_domains.description: Requires an independent declared proof before graph admission; ID membership alone does not prove purity

nominal_domains.name: unplanned
nominal_domains.description: Placeholder refused where finalized executable MIR requires an ownership decision

nominal_domains.name: borrow
nominal_domains.description: Caller retains ownership and the callee cannot escape or release the borrowed owner

nominal_domains.name: move
nominal_domains.description: Transfer the existing ownership obligation exactly once

nominal_domains.name: copy
nominal_domains.description: Create a distinct owned value while preserving the source ownership obligation

nominal_domains.name: uninitialized
nominal_domains.description: No value is available until a dominating store

nominal_domains.name: initialized
nominal_domains.description: Graph verification must prove the dominating initialization

nominal_domains.name: boxed_void
nominal_domains.description: Void result with explicitly declared argument representations and dispositions

nominal_domains.name: unplanned
nominal_domains.description: Placeholder refused by finalized executable link verification

nominal_domains.name: defined
nominal_domains.description: Exactly one module body with identical physical signature and declared linkage

nominal_domains.name: external
nominal_domains.description: Independently declared external ABI and link symbol; no symbol or representation inference

nominal_domains.name: unplanned
nominal_domains.description: Placeholder refused by executable observation verification

nominal_domains.name: says
nominal_domains.description: Existing ordered newline output statement; legacy output NUL limitation remains explicit

nominal_domains.name: print
nominal_domains.description: Existing ordered output statement without newline; legacy output NUL limitation remains explicit

nominal_domains.name: none
nominal_domains.description: No value and therefore no ownership obligation; only valid at a void return

nominal_domains.name: boxed_truthy
nominal_domains.description: Borrowed boxed argument with ownerless scalar Boolean result; MIR graph verifies availability and explicit input retirement

nominal_domains.name: static_code
nominal_domains.description: Process-lifetime immutable code address may be retained asynchronously; no heap ownership obligation

nominal_domains.name: unplanned
nominal_domains.description: Placeholder refused by executable iteration verification

nominal_domains.name: begin
nominal_domains.description: Borrow one live iterable to create a loop-owned snapshot; caller ownership is retired explicitly; arrays and ranges iterate, other values keep the interpreter's length and element errors

nominal_domains.name: advance
nominal_domains.description: Borrow the loop-owned iteration state, step it once and yield an ownerless scalar Boolean that is true while an element remains

nominal_domains.name: current
nominal_domains.description: Borrow the loop-owned iteration state and return one owned element; the iterable itself is never copied

nominal_domains.name: warn
nominal_domains.description: Existing counted stderr observation with newline and borrowed operand

nominal_domains.name: native_scalar
nominal_domains.description: Explicit physical signature with an ownerless scalar result and no implicit boxing

nominal_domains.name: trivial
nominal_domains.description: Ownerless scalar copy or return creates no ownership obligation
